description: A domain report from public data: registrar and expiry (RDAP), hosting and IPv6, email security (MX, SPF, DKIM on common selectors, DMARC, MTA-STS), DNS (name servers, CAA, DNSSEC), the website (HTTP status, HTTPS redirect, security headers) and the TLS certificate (judged from the HTTPS connection; the Certificate Transparency record with issuer and expiry date is in certificate.data.ct when cached, otherwise at certificate.data.ct_url). Each check has a status (good, info, warn, bad, na) and a plain-language explanation; the counts summarize them. Checked once, from one location. The full report is at report_url (/report?domain=<domain> on iplover.com).

domain.description: A domain name, e.g. example.com (no scheme or path).

language.description: Language of the human-readable fields (verdict, explanation, labels).

name: check_domain

counts.description: How many checks are good, info, warn, bad and na (could not check).

mail_servers.description: Network type of the mail server addresses.

report_url.description: Public iplover page with the full report for this domain: share it, or open it for the explanations and sources.

sections.description: domain, hosting, email, dns, website, certificate: each with its data and checks (id, status, text in plain language).

servers.description: Network type of the web server addresses.

title: Check a domain's health
